articles.headline: South Dakota transfer Cameron Fens makes UNC debut in 88-72 win over Marshall
articles.description: Cameron Fens, a 7-foot South Dakota transfer who filed a lawsuit seeking to recover a year cut short by a misdiagnosed foot injury, and was granted a temporary restraining order, made his North Carolina debut, scoring nine points in a win over Marshall.

articles.headline: Jason Crowe Jr. and Bryson Tiller score 18 apiece for Missouri in 91-64 win over Le Moyne

article.story: COOKEVILLE, Tenn. -- — Kyler Fox’s 20 points helped Tennessee Tech defeat Wright State-Lake 101-34 on Sunday. Fox also contributed seven rebounds and four steals for the Golden Eagles (3-2). De’Ante Green scored 14 points, going 6 of 8 (2 for 3 from 3-point range). Caleb Hollenbeck had 12 points and finished 4 of 6 from 3-point range. Charles Cunningham finished with 13 points and three steals for the Lakers, a USCAA Division II team. Xander Kuckuck added eight points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
